note: One entry per material name the pieces use, AS NAMED IN THE GLBS (nothing was renamed). `kind` picks the shader: painted (LagoonPainted with the glb's own texture), glow, water, fall, foam, mist, foliage card (alpha cut, both faces), decal, cloud, unlit. Each approved glb carries its own copy of its atlas: bind the material to the texture INSIDE that glb, or share one texture per name (see `textures`).

textures.sharing: The 24 props share 4 atlases (seta..setd); the terrace, pit, cliff and ground kits share 12 pictures (py_*); every house, gate piece, bulul and stage block has its own. One material per distinct picture is enough: about 78 materials for 246 embedded copies.
